ZinStdJson.Implementation: Pure Zin. No compiler JSON special case.
ZinStdJson.Allocation: Tree/owned decoding requires explicit allocator; streaming/token APIs may be allocation-free.
ZinStdJson.TypedDecode: Typed decode may use comptime reflection to specialize parsing for a destination type.
ZinStdJson.Encode: Encoding to a caller-supplied writer does not allocate unless the selected API explicitly accepts/uses an allocator.
